questions.question: What causes the interference fringes to shift in the Michelson interferometer?

answers.a: Changing the color of the light
answers.c: Altering the path length difference between the two beams

questions.question: How is the wavelength of the He-Ne laser determined using the Michelson interferometer?

answers.a: By measuring the speed of the light source
answers.b: By counting the number of fringes that move as the mirror is displaced
answers.c: By changing the refractive index of air

questions.question: What must be done to measure the refractive index of air using the interferometer?

answers.a: Change the type of laser used
answers.b: Introduce a pressure change and observe the fringe shift

questions.question: Why does the introduction of a vacuum chamber affect the fringe pattern?

answers.a: It alters the wavelength of the laser
answers.b: It changes the refractive index of the medium the light travels through
answers.c: It blocks one of the mirrors
answers.d: It increases the coherence length of the light

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using a Michelson interferometer for wavelength measurement?

answers.a: It is highly complex and expensive
answers.b: It allows precise measurements of very small distances
answers.d: It can only be used for visible light
